SATISH KUMAR NARGANI
Principal Software Engineer
Mobile: +91-8861314369 | Email: satishkumarnargani15@gmail.com

LinkedIn Profile - linkedin.com/in/satishkumarnargani
Location: Bangalore, India

PROFESSIONAL HIGHLIGHTS

Around 14 years of experience in IT Industry with good experience of Architecting Software, Release Management and Managing & Working with Team to deliver projects with multiple domain exposure (Manufacturing, Banking, Oil & Gas).

Worked with various development methodologies like SDLC (Waterfall Model), Agile (Scrum process) and Iterative Software development.

Experience on handling project planning, execution and customer interaction.

Work experience in offshore and onsite model.

Experience in phases of Software development life cycle (SDLC) like Analysis, Design, Estimation, Development, Integration, Testing, Debugging and Maintenance of Enterprise Web and Web services based J2EE Applications in client server environment.

Experience in Agile – Scrum. Involved in some of the SCRUM principles such as Product Planning, Daily Scrum and Retrospection and Iterative Software Development.

Good understanding of OOAD and Java/J2EE Design Patterns for designing application solutions both in high level (HLDs) and low level (LLDs).

Experience in people responsibilities, performance appraisal, career planning & development.

Good familiarity with the process areas like Software Configuration Management, Defect Tracking, and Change Control Management.

Provide guidance and support to different team such as business analyst, UAT team, and other stakeholders.

Expertise in designing and developing scalable, cloud-native solutions following MACH architecture principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).

WORK EXPERIENCE

I am currently working as Principal Software Engineer in PhaseZero from November 2022 till date.

Worked with Oracle as Principal Member Technical Staff from Sep 2021 to November 2022.

Worked with Wipro as Project Lead from August 2019 to September 2021.

Worked with Happiest Minds as Senior Software Engineer from May 2016 to August 2019.

Worked with Tech Mahindra as a Senior Software Engineer from August 2014 to May 2016.

Worked with Valtech India Systems Ltd. as Software Engineer from June 2011 to July 2014

EDUCATION

M.C.A. – Andhra University, Visakhapatnam – 2008

TECHNICAL SKILLS  

Programming Languages:

Java (8-17), J2EE

Frameworks:

Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Cloud(Config,Eureka,Gateway), Spring Security), Hibernate (ORM, JPA)



Microservices:

Microservices Architecture, RESTful Services, API Design and development

DevOps Tools:

CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes

Cloud Platforms:

AWS, Azure

Databases:

Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB

Version Control Systems:

Git, SVN, Bitbucket

IDEs:

Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, NetBeans

Leadership and Management:

Team Leadership

Project Management

Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)

Stakeholder Engagement

Mentorship and Coaching

Performance Appraisal

Resource Planning

Risk Management

Conflict Resolution

ACHIEVEMENT

Completed Azure AZ-900 and AZ-204 Developer Associate

Attended complete workshop of Microservice Architecture Assignment using Cloud and certified in Wipro

OCJP Certified for Java 1.6

PROJECTS PROFILE

Project #1 Title AfterMarket Organization PhaseZero India LLP Role Principal Software Engineer Clients US Based Customers (10+) - Scientific Brake ,Quala,  OPW, Harman,Tectran ,etc. Duration Nov 2022- till date Environment Technologies: Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring JPA, Rest, Apache Kafka, Micro Services, Swagger UI Database: PostgreSQL Tools : IntelliJ IDEA, Git, JIRA Project concept Phase Zero is a Cloud 2.0 company providing SaaS based B2B E-Commerce platform (called Aftermarket) for commercial partners selling products such as Automotive Parts including Industrial Supplies. Responsibilities Analysing Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and translated them into functional specifications and technical solutions. Collaborating with the product team on sprint planning, backlog grooming, and user story refinement. Designed and implemented application structures based on user stories in a multi-tenant environment. Developed and maintained RESTful APIs, ensuring scalability and integration across multiple tenants. Led the Professional Services team, delivering custom client requirements with high quality and within deadlines. Acted as Customer Support Lead, managing and resolving P1/P2 issues, ensuring timely delivery and issue resolution. Integrated various third-party systems, including :ERP APIs (e.g., Karmak, Infor) ,Payment gateways (e.g., CardPointe, PayPal) Procurement platforms (e.g., Coupa) with eCommerce systems Estimated effort and timelines for tasks and deliverables for each release cycle. Conducted code reviews, defect triage, and bug fixing to maintain code quality and stability. Reviewed and tracked team members’ tasks and progress throughout sprints. Owned sprint releases to production, ensuring proper deployment and validation. Managed performance appraisals, career development, and planning for reportees. Project #2 Title EPM Organization Oracle Role Module Lead Client Oracle Duration September 2021- November 2022 Environment Technologies: Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Microservices, Swagger Open API, Tortoise GIT, IntelliJ and Maven, Post Man, Rabbit MQ . Project concept Oracle Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Platform is a framework of the technical and functional components shared among Cloud EPM processes. It enables you to have a more unified user experience and simplified administration across different business functions. Responsibilities Involved in writing restful web service (CRUD Operations). Writing micro services using spring boot with cloud technologies Analysis, Design, Develop API and generating documentation using Swagger Open API definitions Immediate support to product team on any production issues Responsible for effort estimation of task for the release. As an individual developer owning the user stories and completing them Responsible for sprint release to production Responsible for deliverables in coding & testing and reviewing the same
